steps.body: Subtracting a multiple of ten changes only the tens digit, the same way adding one does — just in the other direction.
steps.narration: Subtracting a multiple of ten changes only the tens digit, the same way adding one does — just in the other direction.

widget.prompt: Start at 67. Take away one ten. Where do you land?
widget.missFeedback: Start at 67 and count back 10: you land on 57.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 57 — the tens digit went down by one; the ones stayed at 7.

predict.prompt: You subtract one ten from 67. Which digit changes?
predict.reveal: Subtracting a ten only changes the tens place — the ones digit, 7, is untouched.
